resources.string: We couldn\'t confirm it\'s you, so nothing was changed.
{names}, plus {count, plural, one {# app} other {# apps}} below
Use the TV\'s own home screen
Brings back the TV\'s own home screen. Ours stays installed, so you can switch again.
The home screen settings on the TV changed since you set them.
Updating the home screen on the TV...

Changes made on the TV itself, such as tiles per row or motion, last until you change the home screen here. A dock changed on the TV is not shown above: a new look keeps it, a different dock saved here replaces it. Apps taken off Home on the TV stay off.
Make a button on the TV\'s remote open an app.
{count, plural, one {# button opens an app} other {# buttons open apps}}
A button on the TV\'s remote can open an app you choose, on the home screen and in every app.
The first time, we\'ll also switch on the home screen\'s button helper on the TV. It is an accessibility service, so the TV lists it in its accessibility settings.
Press the button on the TV\'s remote now...
Button {code} is ready. Which app should it open?
The TV can\'t tell this button apart from other buttons on this remote, so it can\'t open an app. Try another button.
The TV needs this button to move around, go back or change the volume, so it stays as it is. Try another button.
No button was pressed. Try again.
The TV didn\'t answer. Check that it is on and try again.
Version {version} is ready. Your dock and look stay as they are.
We\'ll install version {version} over the one on the TV. The dock, the look and the card answers stay. If it is the TV\'s home screen now, it restarts once.
The home screen is up to date: version {version}.
Use the TV\'s own home screen?
We\'ll switch the TV\'s own home screen back on and set it as the home screen. The new home screen stays installed.
Putting the TV\'s own home screen back...
The TV\'s own home screen is back. Ours is still installed.
A black background with four apps along the bottom.
A deep blue background with a soft glow behind the apps.
Six apps across, so more fit on the screen.
Up to {count, spellout} along the bottom. Drag an app by its dots to change the order.
